# BetterTerrainGen-V2 v1.1.1

## 中文

### 新增功能
- **噪声扭曲水深线** — 基于 Simplex 噪声对深度距离场施加扭曲，使海岸线、湖岸线更加自然不规则
- **浅滩零散度 / 浅水零散度** — 新增 Shoal Fragmentation 和 Shallow Water Fragmentation 滑块，在浅滩/浅水区域边缘产生零散的陆地或浅滩小岛，提升真实感
- **水深线噪波频率 / 幅度** — 新增 Depth Warp Noise Scale 和 Depth Warp Magnitude 滑块，控制扭曲细节与强度
- README 顶部新增 GitHub badges（最新版本、下载量、许可证、星标）
- 新增 4 组滑块选项的中英文 bundle 翻译
- 更新测试断言以匹配新的 14 个编辑器选项

---

## English

### What's New
- **Noise-warped depth layers** — Simplex noise warps the depth distance field for more natural, irregular coastlines and lake shores
- **Shoal / Shallow fragmentation** — New Shoal Fragmentation and Shallow Water Fragmentation sliders create scattered land/shoal islets at edges for added realism
- **Depth warp controls** — New Depth Warp Noise Scale and Depth Warp Magnitude sliders to fine-tune warp detail and intensity
- Added GitHub badges (latest release, downloads, license, stars) to README
- Added Chinese & English bundle translations for the 4 new slider options
- Updated test assertion to match the new 14 editor options
